instruction: Open alpha_corpus.txt from Documents and count the case-sensitive whole-word occurrences of banana. Save only the decimal count in Documents\banana_count.txt, then open the output and verify it.
_comments: E1 held-out evaluation variant. Never use it for a human demonstration or Compiler input.

command:
from pathlib import Path; source=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\alpha_corpus.txt'); source.write_text('banana red banana
BANANA stays uppercase
bananas is plural
banana banana blue
banana
yellow banana banana
banana split
banana banana
banana
', encoding='utf-8'); Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents anana_count.txt').unlink(missing_ok=True)
from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\banana_count.txt'); print('true' if p.is_file() and p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip() == '11' else 'false', end='')
